after_verdict_owner: executed-tests.json exact source pins and per-test execution results
baseline_attribution: These observations concern changing implementation bytes, not failures attributed to base #396.

counterexamples.before: Pre-admission backup lacked the original post-backup attempt and origin; cold restore could admit a second effect.
counterexamples.correction: Pre-effect durable closure and complete external cut reconstruct the exact original origin/reservation/attempt.

counterexamples.before: Post-backup strategy switch with no effects lost its current binding and generation on restore.
counterexamples.correction: Complete cut carries all original operating bindings and exact current entry pointer/generation.

counterexamples.before: Older cut could undo restrictive STOP/DRAIN controls or forget an already consumed quote claim.
counterexamples.correction: Restrictive local controls dominate; original pending attempts and consumed claims are imported without resend.

counterexamples.before: Waiting for SQLite writer or credentials could consume the entry deadline after the cached decision clock.
counterexamples.correction: Recheck physical clock under acquired claim transaction and immediately before HTTP.

counterexamples.before: Rounded funding raw amount was treated as a full-notional entry.
counterexamples.correction: Actual paid notional/quantity create PARTIAL; embedded quote fee is counted once.

counterexamples.before: Pending import manufactured a result at the later cut clock, refusing the original earlier callback/model result.
counterexamples.correction: Restore original pending attempt/request without result; accept original frozen PAPER result or SHADOW callback clock.

counterexamples.before: Export could omit a locally accepted post-backup result despite claiming a complete cut.
counterexamples.correction: Export requires exact original receipt for every locally known result absent from backup; conflicts/omissions deny.

counterexamples.before: Invalid remaining quantity/cost basis/entry fee could raise or emit non-finite economics.
counterexamples.correction: Identity-bound typed UNKNOWN preserves known realized legs and cost floors.

counterexamples.before: Cold tick loaded active B profile before servicing due healthy old A; missing/corrupt B stopped A exits and status.
counterexamples.correction: Service each original obligation first; failed active profile/binding disables only new entries and stays visible in independent status.

counterexamples.before: Latest UNKNOWN receipt discarded prior accepted known cumulative cost0.25 during cold restore.
counterexamples.correction: Mandatory original accepted result observations retain IDs/clocks and replay through existing accounting owner before latest receipt.
